subject: Stakeholder rollcall + approval checklist for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@cloverhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot next steps — stakeholder rollcall and approval checklist

Hi Jamie — great call today, thanks for the time.  Quick recap and asks so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: 8-week pilot to validate 10–15% reduction in care-coordination time using Redwood’s hosted inference with private VPC option.
- Key success criteria: latency under 250ms 95th pct, no PHI persistence beyond session, measurable QA uplift on triage routing.

Asks / missing info (can you help confirm?):
1) Economic buyer / budget owner: who signs off on spend? (title + email)
2) Security/legal contacts for SOC2 / data handling review (name + best contact)
3) Procurement process & timeline: RFQ/PO cadence, standard SLAs, required insurance limits, typical review gates
4) Any vendor-onboarding packet or procurement checklist we should fill out?
5) Who else needs to be at an internal kickoff (clinical ops, engineering, privacy)?

I attached a short ROI one-pager and a procurement questions template that usually speeds things up — sending as stubs: [ROI_one-pager.pdf], [procurement-questions.xlsx].

Next step from our side: I'll draft a mutual action plan and a one-page SOW for review once we have the budget owner and procurement path. Could you either: (A) send over an org chart / list of approvers, or (B) introduce me to the right people by reply?

Thanks — aiming to get a kickoff window in the week of May 10 if procurement timing allows.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ROI_one-pager.pdf (attachment stub), procurement-questions.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@cloverhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pilot next steps — stakeholder rollcall and approval checklist

Ben, really appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and I'm looping in procurement as you requested.

1) Economic buyer: Alicia Gomez (VP Clinical Ops) — alicia.gomez@cloverhealth.com (will loop her if you want an intro).
2) Security/legal: Security review goes through Tom Park (Head of Security) — tom.park@cloverhealth.com. Legal typically triages contract language after security sign-off; cc'ing procurement.
3) Procurement process: simple PO for pilots under $50k; for anything above we need a completed vendor packet + approved SOW. Typical review timeline once packet is complete: 7–12 business days.
4) Vendor packet: attaching the procurement mailbox here: procurement@cloverhealth.com — they'll send the required forms.
5) Internal kickoff: recommend Alicia (econ buyer), Dr. Priya Shah (Clinical Director), Tom Park (Security), and an engineering lead (TBD).

I'll send a short org snapshot separately but can do an intro to Alicia & Tom if you want. Procurement (procurement@cloverhealth.com) — would you confirm the standard documents you need? Ben, if you can share the draft SOW and the procurement questions (the spreadsheet you attached), that will speed review.

Thanks,
Jamie
Jamie Lee
Director, Care Transformation | Clover Health
jamie.lee@cloverhealth.com

Proposed next steps & timeline:
- Today (Tue): internal owners assigned (Marissa / Laura) — owners acknowledged by EOD
- Wed–Thu: security packet prep + SOW iteration
- Fri: mutual action plan shared with Jamie + Alicia
- Week of May 10: target kickoff if procurement clears

Any objections to that cadence? Procurement (procurement@cloverhealth.com) — please confirm whether we should submit the vendor packet before or after Alicia signs the SOW.

Ben
